tests.estimand: Participant-held-out drift shares for acceleration, force, impulse, power, and work in frozen event windows, reported signed and magnitude-normalized with cancellation.
tests.null: The registered drift contribution is negligible after propagated measurement, synchronization, inverse-dynamics, and convention uncertainty.
tests.falsifier: The interval overlaps the negligible region, changes sign under a registered frame or convention, or forward killswitch persistence is absent.

tests.estimand: Held-out change in pathway sign and magnitude across measured moment arm, relative angle, force-velocity projection, grip separation, and swing-plane orientation.
tests.null: Geometry variables add no held-out predictive or sign-gating value after full-state conditioning.
tests.falsifier: Registered null/reversal contrasts do not change the proposed pathway or fail across participant holdouts.

tests.estimand: Conditional effect of early proximal acceleration, distal release, and braking timing on delivery outcomes at matched measured work and state.
tests.null: Timing variables add no held-out outcome value and registered casting definitions disagree without a stable effect.
tests.falsifier: The effect vanishes under matched work/state, reverses across plausible casting definitions, or incurs the adverse load margin.

tests.estimand: Participant-held-out timing-region width and perturbation recovery, including error decay, recovery time, and viable-set return probability.
tests.null: The proposed strategy has no larger timing region or recovery probability after effort and load matching.
tests.falsifier: Any apparent robustness disappears under observer-delay/noise sensitivity or depends on an adverse force, effort, or orientation increase.

tests.estimand: Participant-held-out proximal-rate and acceleration dose-response for speed, distal energy, braking, grip load, and orientation under matched work and state.
tests.null: No stable nonmonotonic surface or benefit remains after conditioning and uncertainty propagation.
tests.falsifier: A claimed monotonic benefit contains a plateau, reversal, interior optimum, matching-rule dependence, or adverse load margin.

tests.estimand: Class-specific association of contact disengagement, transmission dead zone, structural preload, biological series compliance, or control deadband with transfer and load outcomes.
tests.null: No separately identified slack class improves the registered outcome after matched energy and load.
tests.falsifier: The result depends on conflating classes, fails passivity or energy accounting, or vanishes under the zero-slack/matched-energy comparator.

completion_gate: Requires governed synchronized participant-level data and frozen participant-held-out results; synthetic dry runs and published group summaries do not satisfy this registration.
inference_boundary: Observed association or prediction does not establish a causal coaching strategy.
